tasks.short: Liaise between managers, tenants, and owners

steps.what: Open the stored contact for owners
Act as liaisons between on-site managers or tenants and owners

tasks.design: The manager acts as a liaison between on-site managers or tenants and owners. {DOCS} opens a stored owner contact. A missing contact stays blank. The conversation stays at full effort. Finding the contact is the only shorter piece.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager hunted for a phone number and then made the call.
tasks.enabler_now: A property identifier can open a contact the manager stored earlier.
tasks.still_hard: Carrying the message between the people stays a conversation.
tasks.human_edge: The manager will not pass on a complaint they have not heard themselves.
tasks.altitude: The liaison stays a conversation. Only the search for the owner's contact is shorter.

reach.learn: Which points the owner wants held back.

evidence.claim: A stored property identifier can open an owner contact. Acting as the liaison stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a message to pass and ends when the manager has spoken with the owner or the tenant, or stops.
A contact row has property identifier, person name, and phone, entered by the manager. A missing phone is left blank.
Opening the contact does not shorten the conversation. No new list is kept.
unknowns: Which tenant messages the owner wants to hear directly.
research_questions: How often was the stored contact wrong, so the manager still searched?

already_counted.description: Acting as liaison between tenants and owners is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the conversation adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the contact is often blank, so the manager still searches and then talks. High: the contact opens, and the liaison conversation still takes the call. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Write the request for bids for repairs and renovations
Review the bid request before contractors are asked
Send the accepted request to solicit those bids
Line up returned amounts for maintenance bids
Analyze the bids and choose the contractor

tasks.design: The manager solicits and analyzes bids from contractors for repairs, renovations, and maintenance. The manager writes the request and reviews it. {EMAIL} sends only the accepted request. {DOCS} lines up returned amounts. A blank amount is left out of the lineup. The manager analyzes and chooses.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager typed each request and compared bids on paper.
tasks.enabler_now: An accepted request can be sent as written. Returned amounts can be lined up.
tasks.still_hard: Writing what the repair is, and choosing the contractor, stay with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager rejects a low bid that leaves out part of the repair.
tasks.altitude: The request goes out only after the manager accepts that version. The choice of contractor stays theirs.

reach.task: Approve a bid above the usual repair limit
reach.learn: Which repairs the owner wants a second bid for.

evidence.claim: An accepted bid request can be sent, and returned amounts can be lined up. Choosing the contractor stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a repair to price and ends when the manager has chosen a contractor or stopped.
A returned bid has contractor identifier, repair identifier, and amount, copied from the contractor's form by the manager. A blank amount is left blank and is omitted from the lineup.
The send uses the request accepted in the review. The lineup does not choose a contractor.
unknowns: How many bids the owner expects before a repair is awarded.
research_questions: How often did the lineup omit a bid because the amount was blank?

already_counted.description: Analyzing the bids and choosing a contractor is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Correct a bid amount that does not match the contractor's returned form.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: requests are rewritten each time, so sending is a small part. High: the request is accepted and sent, amounts line up, and the manager still chooses. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Open the stored financial and operational status
Meet with clients to negotiate management and service contracts
Determine priorities and discuss the status of properties

tasks.design: The manager meets clients to negotiate management and service contracts, determines priorities, and discusses the financial and operational status of properties. {ERP} opens the stored status. A missing figure stays blank. The meeting stays at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager gathered figures before the meeting and negotiated from memory.
tasks.enabler_now: A property identifier can open a status already posted.
tasks.still_hard: Negotiating the contract and setting priorities stay a meeting.
tasks.human_edge: The manager will not agree a fee the status sheet does not support.
tasks.altitude: The negotiation stays the meeting. The status is only easier to open.

reach.task: Set the fee and the term they will accept
reach.learn: Which terms the owner has already ruled out.

evidence.claim: A stored property identifier can open a financial and operational status. Negotiating the contract stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a client meeting and ends when priorities are set or the manager stops.
A status row has property identifier, period, and amount, entered from posted bills. A blank amount is left blank and is not discussed as zero.
Opening the status does not shorten the negotiation. No contract is sent in this task.
unknowns: Which contract terms the client expects to see in writing after the meeting.
research_questions: How often did the manager set the status sheet aside during the negotiation?

already_counted.description: Negotiating management contracts with clients is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the meeting adds no record beyond the notes the manager already keeps.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the status is often blank, so the meeting is unchanged. High: the status opens, and negotiating the contract still takes the meeting. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Clean areas and make minor repairs

steps.what: Clean common areas and change light bulbs

tasks.design: The manager cleans common areas, changes light bulbs, and makes minor property repairs. Nothing is written to {DOCS}. The work stays physical at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager walks the common areas with a cloth and a bulb.
tasks.enabler_now: No stored record makes the cleaning or the repair shorter.
tasks.still_hard: The cleaning and the repair stay in the manager's hands.
tasks.human_edge: The manager sees a repair that is no longer minor and stops.
tasks.altitude: Nothing material changes. The round stays physical.

reach.task: Take a repair the manager judges is not minor
reach.learn: Which faults the manager should not attempt.

evidence.claim: Cleaning, changing bulbs, and minor repairs stay manual. No record makes that work shorter.

assumptions: The work starts in the common area and ends when the area is clean or the minor repair is done, or the manager stops.
No new record is required. Upkeep is zero.
A repair that needs a contractor is handed on and is not finished in this task.
unknowns: Which repairs the site treats as minor.
research_questions: How often did a minor repair turn into a contractor job once the manager started?

already_counted.description: Cleaning common areas and changing bulbs is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the physical round adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every area is still cleaned by hand. High: the same round remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The manager still inspects sites, meets people, and decides rents, eligibility, and staff matters. A payment, contract, purchase, advertisement, or record is sent or written only after the manager accepts that version.
reach: An owner receives only a budget or a payment list the manager has accepted.
A contractor receives only a bid request or a contract the manager has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when an amount, a date, or a required document is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a send or a write.
Keep site inspections, tenant conversations, and eligibility decisions in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every property has a budget and a record the owner can trust, and the manager still decides the exception.

job.title: Property, Real Estate, and Community Association Managers
